title: Drosophila calibration reference evidence ledger
coverage_claim: Audited, non-exhaustive subset. No claim that every published measurement or dataset was found or extracted.
freeze_scope: Values and provenance transcribed here only; no simulation parameters fitted, no external raw datasets downloaded, and no biological acceptance tolerance invented.

status_definitions.VERIFIED: Relevant primary text/figure/table or repository statement inspected; scope is recorded per entry. Does not mean all metadata or the raw files are verified.
status_definitions.REPORTED: Not fully primary-audited; secondary citation or indexed excerpt only. Not admitted for fitting.

missing_values: JSON null is unknown/unextracted, never zero. Each relevant missing-value reason is explicit.

rungs.6: reserved, unspecified by user, held out

fit_policy.reason: This is an evidence snapshot, not approval to fit; preparation and observation mapping must be preregistered. Rung 5 and reserved rung 6 must never be fitted.

observation_models.unitary_EPSP: Compare simulated somatic ΔV following one presynaptic axonal spike, under matched baseline/release history. One ORN→PN uEPSP aggregates multiple anatomical release sites; do not assign 6.19 mV to every EM contact.
observation_models.EPSC: Requires a current/conductance observation model with holding voltage, reversal potential and soma filtering; not interchangeable with EPSP amplitude.
observation_models.B1: Use graded membrane voltage / Fourier amplitude and phase. Nonspiking B1 signals cannot be assessed solely by firing rate. Electrical and chemical contributions require an explicit model distinction.
observation_models.calcium: Simulate latent calcium from spikes and/or voltage, indicator kinetics/nonlinearity, baseline fluorescence, ROI mixing and sample rate; calculate ΔF/F exactly as the experiment. Do not infer absolute Hz from an uncalibrated calcium curve.
observation_models.normalized_tuning: Apply the same per-cell/trial normalization to model and experiment. Compare shape/rank/indices only unless an absolute observation mapping is independently calibrated.
observation_models.CAP: Extracellular compound action potentials require a weighted, filtered population spike/synchrony model; CAP amplitude is not average per-JO Hz.
observation_models.behavior: Preserve stimulus/behavior time alignment and within-fly sampling. Turning or courtship changes are downstream validation, not direct synaptic-gain measurements.
observation_models.stimulus_IPI: IPI is a stimulus timing coordinate. 35 ms IPI is not a vpoEN or vpoDN firing rate.

not_measured_or_not_established: A universal mV-per-EM-contact conversion is not established by these unitary-connection measurements.
No scalar conversion from physical sound particle velocity or visual contrast to the bench's chosen Poisson drive was verified.
No calibrated absolute Hz mapping for the LC10a/vpo GCaMP responses was verified.
35 ms is the strongest tested IPI condition, not a measured distribution of continuous best-IPI values.
No universal acceptable error tolerance follows directly from an SEM, SD, or p-value.
Recording temperature must not be replaced with rearing temperature.
Uniform L1/L2 population drive is not a retinotopic moving-target stimulus.
Missing extracted numbers for Ribeiro/Azevedo/Schretter are retrieval/extraction gaps, not evidence those quantities were never measured.
